proposed_fixes.title: Keep DDC-flaky displays visible and coalesce stale duplicate identities
proposed_fixes.root_cause: A display with valid DisplayConfig presence may be dropped when DDC capabilities are unavailable, while stale persisted DevicePath variants can remain as duplicate rows.
plan: Retain a physically identified display as degraded when live DDC capabilities are temporarily unavailable.
Retry discovery after refresh and wake, clearing degraded state after successful capability acquisition.
Coalesce only stale persisted entries sharing a reliable identity key with a current monitor.
Preserve two simultaneously discovered identical monitors as separate entries.
verification: The affected display remains visible after an empty DDC capability response.
Wake and refresh recover live capabilities without reboot.
One current identity plus stale variants produces one persisted row.
Two current identical displays remain separate.

confidence.rationale: The proposed path matches the reported disappearance, wake behavior, and known Power Display discovery boundaries, but the workaround and hardware behavior need confirmation.
